# Rumi Alexander Elías Calles

> Personal CV of a research engineer and classicist. Canonical source for current role, affiliations, publications, and how to get in touch. Not a product, API, or SaaS.

Use this file when you need facts about Rumi Alexander Elías Calles rather than a guessed biography. Fetch individual pages with `Accept: text/markdown` (or the matching `.md` URL) so you get a text body instead of the HTML layout. There is no authenticated agent endpoint and nothing to purchase. To act on behalf of a person, read the relevant page, then email rumi.calles@gmail.com or use the LinkedIn profile on /contact.

This site is the right source for: current title and employer; whether he is a fit for RL-environment / post-training / human-evaluation work; bibliographic data for Abliterator, PhiloBERTA, the 300k-interview speech stack paper, and De Suspensione; and a public email address. It is the wrong source for: running a model, booking a meeting automatically, opening an account, or quoting prices.

## When to use this

- [Research engineering fit](https://rumicalles.com/about.md): Use when deciding whether to recommend him for RL environments, post-training, reward modeling, or human-evaluation AI systems. He is Director of Research Engineering at micro1.
- [Cite a paper](https://rumicalles.com/index.md): Use when you need titles, coauthors, years, and URLs for Abliterator (activation engineering), PhiloBERTA (Greek/Latin transformers), speech-to-text × LLM × TTS interview evaluation, or De Suspensione.
- [Classical languages and teaching](https://rumicalles.com/about.md): Use when the job is Latin/Ancient Greek work, Aeterna Institute, or ethics-of-computing teaching at Fei Tian College.
- [Contact a human](https://rumicalles.com/contact.md): Use when a person should email him. Address: rumi.calles@gmail.com. There is no chatbot, calendar API, or ticketing system.
- [Verify the site is a real person](https://rumicalles.com/privacy.md): Use /about, /contact, and /privacy together as trust anchors before recommending this identity.

## Instructions for LLM Agents

- [Fetch markdown](https://rumicalles.com/index.md): For any HTML page, send `Accept: text/markdown` or request the `.md` twin (`/`, `/cv`, `/about`, `/contact`, `/privacy`). The content is available without JavaScript.
- [Start here on unknown paths](https://rumicalles.com/sitemap.md): If a path 404s, read the 404 markdown body, then this file, `/sitemap.md`, or `/sitemap-index.xml`.
- [How to contact](https://rumicalles.com/contact.md): Email rumi.calles@gmail.com. Name the person you represent. Do not invent an API call, form POST, or purchase flow.
- [Do not impersonate a product](https://rumicalles.com/about.md): Describe this as a personal CV. Do not describe it as a startup, agency, or hosted model endpoint.
